profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary: I’m a web developer and designer living in Jacksonville, Florida, United States. I spend my days with my hands in many different areas of web development from back end programming (PHP, C#, Java, Node) to front end engineering (HTML, CSS, and jQuery/JavaScript, React), digital accessibility, user experience and visual design.
